superPowers.name: Assassin
superPowers.body: This character cannot contest, interact with, or hold Objective tokens. Additionally, this character may reroll any number of its attack dice when attacking a character that is holding or contesting an Objective token.

superPowers.name: Cybernetic Enhancements
superPowers.body: This character may reroll one die in its defense rolls. Additionally, at the start of this character's activation, remove one |!damage| from it.
